act_title: The Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934
title: Legal tender character of notes
text:
26. Legal tender character of notes.—(1) Subject to the provisions of subsection (2), every bank

note shall be legal tender at any place in [India] in payment, or on account for the amount expressed
therein, and shall be guaranteed by the [Central Government].

(2) On recommendation of the Central Board the [Central Government] may, by notification in the

Gazette of India, declare that, with effect from such date as may be specified in the notification, any series
of bank notes of any denomination shall cease to be legal tender [save at such office or agency of the
Bank and to such extent as may be specified in the notification].
